defects.title: WC-4 single contract path contradicts adversarial, workflow and file-valued --output rows
defects.quote: In unattended mode the command writes `<output-dir>/return-contract.yaml`, where `<output-dir>` is the directory the coordinator passed (`--output` / `--output-dir`).
defects.what_goes_wrong: WC-4 puts the contract at <output-dir>/return-contract.yaml known before dispatch, but the adversarial row moves it to <output>/adversarial/return-contract.yaml, workflow writes it into a run-generated .dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/ package with no passed directory (and no location at all for the pre-creation STOP the row requires), and tdd/init-lite pass --output <file> so <output-dir> is a file; 7.2 step 3-4, AC-1.2 and AC-2.2 then check a path where the file is not or cannot be, and WC-5 maps the missing report to failed.
defects.is_fixed_when: For adversarial, workflow (including a pre-creation STOP), tdd and init-lite the spec states one contract path that WC-4, the section 3.1 row, 2.3 and the 7.2 step 3-4 / AC-1.2 / AC-1.4 / AC-2.2 checks all agree on, and that path is either known from the brief before dispatch or WC-4/2.3/7.2 explicitly say the coordinator takes it from worker_done --report-path for that command.
defects.deletion_note: No: removing the contract requirement or dropping these ready commands from worker scope would remove the coordinator's only report read path rather than reconcile it; narrowing WC-4 to defer to per-row paths is a valid fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: WC-4 (62), 2.3 brief (73), section 3 intro definition of Contract (76), rows adversarial (83), init-lite (87), tdd (90), workflow (92), spec-panel add --output (120), 7.2 steps 3-4 (182-183), AC-1.2 (196), AC-1.4 (198), AC-2.2 (200).

defects.title: Commands with no output flag or generated report paths cannot meet WC-4 'known before dispatch'
defects.what_goes_wrong: cleanup-audit (fixed .claude-audit/), index-repo (brief passes none), research, recommend, review-translation, save, task, cli-portify (location unnamed), cli-eval (run-id dir) and implement (beside a slug ledger) gain no flag that sets the contract directory, so the brief cannot state the WC-4 path and AC-1.2 ('--unattended --output <dir>') / AC-2.3 7.2 step 3 ('report path is the WC-4 contract path') cannot be passed as written.
defects.is_fixed_when: Every section 3 command that writes a contract either gains an output flag (or fixed stated path) from which WC-4 derives a contract path known before dispatch, or WC-4/2.3 and 7.2 steps 3-4 explicitly let the worker report a generated path via --report-path for that named command, and AC-1.2/AC-2.3 invoke each command with flags it actually accepts.
defects.deletion_note: Partly: removing a command from the worker/contract scope (and from AC-1.1/AC-1.2/AC-2.3) would remove the contradiction for that command, but only if section 3, P1/P2 scope and the checks all drop it consistently.

defects.title: AC-0.4 P0 smoke check requires WC-4 contract before Phase 1 creates it
defects.quote: step 4 uses the command's existing report file, since the contract arrives in P1
defects.what_goes_wrong: AC-0.4 requires 7.2 step 3 to pass ('its --outcome matches the contract's status under WC-5; its report path is the WC-4 contract path') in P0, when no WC-4 contract exists, and step 4's YAML assertion on troubleshoot's markdown REPORT.md fails (verified: KeyError 'status'), so the P0 gate cannot pass for /sc:troubleshoot as written.
defects.is_fixed_when: AC-0.4 states P0-specific pass conditions for steps 3 and 4 (which report path the worker passes and what is checked in place of the YAML contract assertion for each smoke command) that can be met by the commands' existing outputs.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting AC-0.4 would drop the only check closing evidence gap 1.4(1); replacing its step 3-4 conditions is the fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: 7.2 steps 3-4 (182-183), section 1.4 gap 1 (43), P0 row (158), troubleshoot row (91), WC-5 (63).

defects.title: a3-r6 revision: WC-4 names contracts for cleanup-audit/init-lite that no phase builds
defects.quote: a3-r6 final spec (p11/runs/a3-r6/aud/ws/.dev/orca-command-refactor/specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md:76): "adversarial, brainstorm, cleanup-audit, index-repo, init-lite and workflow gain none (REQ-2)"; line 62: "cleanup-audit `.claude-audit/return-contract.yaml` (fixed directory, no flag)"
defects.what_goes_wrong: The a3-r6 revision gives cleanup-audit and init-lite contract paths in WC-4 and a 2.3 retry that 'rewrites the contract there', yet removes their Unattended mode section and lists no contract work in P1, so the contract is never written and WC-5 ('no report exists') reports successful runs as failed.
defects.is_fixed_when: Every command for which WC-4 or 2.3 names a contract path is also assigned contract-writing work in a named phase (and covered by AC-1.1 or an equivalent check), or WC-4/2.3/WC-5 state that those commands report their existing named file and how it maps to an outcome.
defects.deletion_note: Yes, if the WC-4 exception entries and the 2.3 cleanup-audit sentence are removed and the worker is told to report the existing named file; the original spec (P1 adds the contract to every 3.1/3.2 command) did not have this gap.

defects.title: b1-r3 revision: ready commands with no fix never get a contract, reported failed
defects.quote: b1-r3 final spec (p13/ab1/runs/b1-r3/aud/ws/.dev/orca-command-refactor/specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md:76): "`load` and the ready commands with no fix get neither."
defects.what_goes_wrong: In the b1-r3 revision init-lite (and brainstorm) get no Unattended mode section or contract in any phase, while 3.1 says the worker reports the named file 'until Phase 1 adds the contract' and the revised WC-5 sends --outcome failed for an unparseable or unknown-status report, so a successful init-lite worker is always reported failed.
defects.is_fixed_when: init-lite and every other 3.1 command with 'None' fix either gain a WC-4 contract in a named phase, or WC-5 states which non-contract report forms map to succeeded so a successful run is not reported failed.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting init-lite from worker scope would contradict the 10-ready verdict; the fix is to assign the contract or define the mapping (the original spec's P1 covered every 3.1 command).
defects.present_in_others_hint: b1-r3 section 3 intro (76), 3.1 intro (79), init-lite row (87), brainstorm row (84), WC-5 (63), P1 row (159), AC-1.1 (195).
